latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — quickly turn text prompts and files into shareable AI-generated videos.

- Converts TXT, DOCX, PDF, and SRT files (up to 200MB) into ready-to-share 1080p MP4 videos in about 1–2 minutes.
- No editing skills required; just upload or enter your text and describe your video.
- Offers automatic session setup using free credits with simple authentication flow.
- Supports exporting, credits checking, video status, timeline preview, and multi-file batch workflows.
- Handles user requests via smart, intent-based action routing for a seamless experience.
